description: Recipes from the Pierson family of Rosemeade Township in Ransom County, North Dakota, specifically from sisters Caroline (Pierson) Granlund and Emma (Pierson) Siverson. The recipes were compiled by their descendant Ella (Granlund) Mathiesen-Wallevand.
